title: Wrongdoing Tracker / Elite Power Case Engine
mission: Uncover wrongdoing, track elite power, map the money, follow the files and expose protection networks through public records.
boundary: This is a public-record case engine. It separates confirmed wrongdoing, alleged misconduct, institutional failure, legal settlements, open leads and speculation. Association, wealth, status, travel capacity or proximity are not proof of wrongdoing.

evidenceGrades.A: confirmed by conviction, plea, court finding, official enforcement action, regulatory order, authenticated exhibit or primary public filing
evidenceGrades.B: strong documented lead from reputable reporting, multiple records, settlement, testimony or institutional review, but not a final finding
evidenceGrades.C: open lead requiring source pull, counter-source and confidence review
evidenceGrades.X: rejected, false, unsupported, misidentified, private/sensitive, or speculation quarantined

caseTypes.name: Confirmed wrongdoing
caseTypes.purpose: Cases with conviction, plea, regulator finding, official enforcement action or court finding.
caseTypes.requiredRecord: judgment, plea, enforcement order, regulator release, court finding or official sanction
caseTypes.cannotShow: broader guilt of associates, institutions or unrelated elite networks without separate records

caseTypes.name: Alleged misconduct
caseTypes.purpose: Claims in lawsuits, testimony, sworn statements, investigative reports or official allegations that require separation from findings.
caseTypes.requiredRecord: complaint, deposition, affidavit, hearing transcript, investigative report or public allegation with response
caseTypes.cannotShow: final truth unless accepted by court, admitted, corroborated or independently verified

caseTypes.name: Institutional failure
caseTypes.purpose: Banks, universities, foundations, regulators, companies or public bodies failing due diligence, compliance, oversight or protection duties.
caseTypes.requiredRecord: institutional review, enforcement action, settlement, OIG report, regulator finding, audit or public corrective action
caseTypes.cannotShow: every individual inside the institution knew or intended wrongdoing

caseTypes.name: Money movement
caseTypes.purpose: Payments, donations, grants, contracts, settlements, political money, filings, offshore entities and property/entity trails.
caseTypes.requiredRecord: filing, Form 990, SEC/ADV, court exhibit, OpenSecrets/FEC, contract, settlement or official register
caseTypes.cannotShow: motive, quid pro quo or hidden control without additional evidence

caseTypes.name: Legal suppression / silence
caseTypes.purpose: NDAs, sealed records, discovery fights, settlements, threat letters, retractions and delayed disclosure.
caseTypes.requiredRecord: court docket, motion to seal/unseal, settlement reporting, legal correspondence, public statement or order
caseTypes.cannotShow: truth of underlying claim unless the record supports it

caseTypes.name: Reputation laundering
caseTypes.purpose: Use of philanthropy, media, academia, think tanks, events or prestige institutions to launder reputation or access.
caseTypes.requiredRecord: donation record, event record, email, review, public statement, archive or reporting with documents

caseTypes.name: Transport / logistics evidence
caseTypes.purpose: Historical flight logs, court exhibits, public registry context, schedules, staff logistics and transport references.
caseTypes.requiredRecord: court exhibit, released log, official registry context, schedule, email or public record
caseTypes.cannotShow: live location, passenger identity, travel purpose or guilt by itself

caseTypes.name: Open cabal lead
caseTypes.purpose: A power-structure lead that may connect people, money, institutions and records but is not yet proven.
caseTypes.requiredRecord: trigger record, source route, falsification test and next pull task

trackerCards.title: Epstein / Maxwell confirmed criminal case lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Convictions, charges, plea records, sentencing, court exhibits, flight-log exhibits, survivor testimony and official disclosures.
trackerCards.nextPull: Link every Epstein/Maxwell page to conviction/finding/exhibit lanes and separate them from open association claims.
trackerCards.grade: A for court findings; C for open association leads

trackerCards.title: Elite access and protection network lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Who had access, who enabled access, who ignored warnings, who continued contact, who controlled institutions and who benefited from reputation cover.
trackerCards.nextPull: For each access claim, add date, source, role, denial/response and whether the record proves contact, access, money or misconduct.

trackerCards.title: Banking / compliance failure lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Banking relationships, suspicious activity, monitoring failures, settlements, enforcement actions and compliance reviews.
trackerCards.nextPull: Pull the enforcement/settlement language and classify finding, allegation, settlement, admission or denial.
trackerCards.grade: A for enforcement finding; B for settlement/reporting; C for lead

trackerCards.title: Foundation / university prestige lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Donations, anonymous gifts, donor access, institutional review findings, event attendance, science/academic prestige and public corrective action.
trackerCards.nextPull: Pull donation amount/date, office involved, review findings, denial/response and policy changes.
trackerCards.grade: A for primary records; B for documented reporting

trackerCards.title: Political money and lobbying lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Donations, PACs, lobbying clients, foreign-agent registrations, policy outcomes and public access routes.
trackerCards.nextPull: Record amount/date/recipient/client/issue and avoid implying quid pro quo without records.
trackerCards.grade: A for filings; C for influence inference

trackerCards.title: Legal suppression and sealed-record lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Motions to seal/unseal, NDAs, settlements, retractions, threat letters, discovery fights and delayed disclosures.
trackerCards.nextPull: Separate sealed-record existence from contents; log date, judge, parties and outcome.
trackerCards.grade: A for docket event; B/C for implications

trackerCards.title: Transport and logistics evidence lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Historical transport records, released flight logs, staff schedules, public registry context and court-filed exhibits.
trackerCards.nextPull: Separate owner/operator/charter/passenger claim; do not publish live personal movement or private addresses.
trackerCards.grade: A for exhibit/registry fact; C for inference

trackerCards.title: Media and reputation management lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Narrative repair, press strategy, article corrections, ownership influence, public denial timing and reputation rebuilding.
trackerCards.nextPull: Archive before/after pages, original claims, corrections, ownership links and response statements.
trackerCards.grade: A for archive/page change; C for motive

trackerCards.title: Offshore / entity structure lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Offshore entities, shell companies, officers, beneficial ownership leads, property/entity layers and public registries.
trackerCards.nextPull: Verify with primary registry and avoid treating entity use as wrongdoing without records.
trackerCards.grade: A for registry fact; C for intent

trackerCards.title: Counter-source / falsification lane
trackerCards.whatToTrack: Corrections, debunks, court rejections, fake documents, date errors, misidentified people and innocent explanations.
trackerCards.nextPull: Attach one counter-source to every high-risk page before upgrading confidence.
trackerCards.grade: X if rejected; B/A if boundary corrected
